scope: Borrowed-slice multiprecision arithmetic; partial library API
representation: Little-endian base-2^64 words interpreted as nonnegative mathematical integers

modules.scope: Range, precision, decomposition, congruence, Karatsuba and low-product identities
Scalar and slice arithmetic, carries, borrows, absolute differences and precision normalization; in-place exact borrow and canonical modular subtraction
Schoolbook, difference Karatsuba, low-product recursion and canonical modular multiplication under explicit interface preconditions
Three-block decomposition, five-point polynomial identities, coefficient bounds, recomposition and square symmetry
Padded arithmetic, exact division, signed evaluation, in-place interpolation and shifted modular accumulation
Recursive full/low Toom multiplication, dedicated recursive squares, a symmetry-specialized low-square basecase selected for top-level sizes 25 through 64 and fixed modular dispatch
modules.low_square_base_word_multiplications: For 25 <= n <= 64, k = ceil(n/2) and h = floor(n/2): k(k+1)/2 + h(h+1)/2, versus n(n+1)/2 for the generic low product; analytic count, not a composed cost theorem

modules.scope: Four-word row unrolling with exact carry and short tail; not selected by default
Independent triangular cross-product/diagonal decomposition equals the mathematical square
Full symmetry-specialized basecase square; checked carries, no scratch, default full-square leaves from 8 limbs
modules.cost: n(n-1)/2 cross multiplications and n diagonal multiplications, O(n^2) word operations and O(1) extra words; analytic count, no composed cost theorem

resource_contract: Karatsuba full 3n / low 4n; Toom full/low product 12n, full/low square 10n; checked actual recursive slice capacity and strict decreases
cost_status: Fixed-threshold Toom O(n^log3(5)) word bound is analytically derived from source recursion; no checked composed cost theorem
remaining: General division, inversion and higher-level integer APIs
